newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.

Traders said the rates moved narrowly in slow trading, with banks and other financial institutions having less money to trade due to payments required this week to the Finance Ministry for underwriting seven-year treasury bonds.
The bonds are being issued from November 1 to 20.

Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the People's Bank of China, were major traders today on behalf of securities houses, who needed short-term money to trade on surging domestic share markets, traders said.
Traders expect the rates to move in a narrow range in the next few days. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
